capabilities_done: extract_library(Grant, Limits, LibraryLimits, CancellationToken) -> LibraryProposal: one bounded pass inside the same before/after fingerprint; catalog part equals extract_catalog for the same grant (test library_mapping_keeps_catalog_and_types_state); typed Flag (pick/reject/unflagged), ColorLabel (default five names, other text Custom + color_label_custom_text), rating u8 0..5; LibraryCollectionKind collection/smart collection/collection set (+ collection_kind_unmapped for unknown creation ids); parent_not_collection_set, smart_rules_absent, rules_on_non_smart_collection, rules_collection_unresolved, synonym_keyword_unresolved losses; library counts for AgLibraryCollectionContent and AgLibraryKeywordSynonym (rows_seen == mapped + lost from walker + whole-row loss events); resolves lists the catalog loss codes the library layer translated

parse_smart_rules(bytes, RuleLimits) -> SmartRules: non-executing tokenizer of the Lua table literal (escapes decoded first incl. decimal escapes, quoted and long-bracket strings, line and long comments, numbers incl. hex/exponent, true/false/nil); typed RuleGroup (combine intersect/union/exclude -> All/Any/NoneOf, nested groups) and RuleCriterion (criteria/operation typed with raw kept, value/value2 scalars); every unrecognised name or field is an aggregated note -> Approximate LossNote; refused rows are whole-row losses named by the rule error code

hostile input: RuleLimits (input bytes, depth, node count, string bytes; zero or above hard ceilings = rule_limit_configuration) checked before the allocation each guards (test smart_rule_bombs_refused_before_allocation: 100k-deep nesting, 10k-item table, 5000-byte quoted and long-bracket strings, 100-digit and overflowing hex numbers, over-size input); retained rule trees, states and hierarchy entries charged against the extraction-wide max_retained_text_bytes (same test: the smallest budget the fixed extraction fits in fails extract_library with limit_retained_text)

resolve_hierarchy(items, max_depth) -> [HierarchyNode]: O(n) parent-forest validation for collections and keywords; parent cycles and self-parents detached (parent_cycle), unknown parents parent_unresolved, repeated ids duplicate_rowid, nesting beyond max_hierarchy_depth (default 256, hard 4096) hierarchy_depth_exceeded; order-independent (test hierarchy_cycles_unresolved_and_depth_cap: 100k-deep chain, 100k ring, reversed input)

extract_catalog behaviour unchanged: refactored into extract_with(grant, limits, cancel, extra) where extra runs after the catalog proposal is complete (and receives it) and before the closing fingerprint, with its own loss log and counts; all 9 pre-existing crate tests pass unchanged except the PUBLIC_ENTRYPOINTS assertion and the no-SQL source list, which now include the new entrypoints and modules

slice B decode_xmp_packet(bytes, XmpLimits) -> XmpLibraryFields: bounded RDF/XML reader for xmp:Rating (-1 Rejected, 0..5 Stars, other values noted), xmp:Label, dc:subject bag items, lr:hierarchicalSubject split at |; attribute and element property forms; entity/character references decoded before comparison, comments/PI/CDATA recognised, names resolved by namespace URI with scoped xmlns (default namespace included), DOCTYPE refused, references in unkept text still validated; XmpLimits (input bytes, depth, nodes = elements + attributes + xmlns, keywords, value bytes; zero or above hard ceilings = xmp_limit_configuration) checked before the allocation each guards (tests xmp_fields_namespace_and_adversarial_xml, xmp_bombs_refused_before_allocation)

spec_basis: STU-ASSET-001: 'CKC is the single asset library, media catalog and file manager for Studio ... Studio does not have an asset library of its own and MUST NOT acquire one.'

STU-ASSET-004: 'Studio MUST NOT implement, and MUST NOT ship ... a second metadata, keyword, rating, label or flag store; a second collection or smart-collection mechanism over assets ... Standalone reusable assets MUST consume artifact/catalog bytes through injected typed provider ports.'

STU-ASSET-019: Studio's asset projection inherits, and MUST NOT re-implement, CKC's 'hierarchical keyword tagging, 0-to-5 star rating, colour labels, pick/reject/unflagged flags, manual collections, rule-based smart collections ... EXIF/IPTC/XMP metadata read and write'
STU-ASSET-017: a Studio-local asset index, cache or metadata table is forbidden; the projection holds no catalog state

module 14 SQLite exception (line 47): the .lrcat decoder MUST NOT 'establish a private database/cache/catalog'; it 'emits typed import proposals and provenance/loss receipts; accepted data enters existing CKC and Studio schemas through ResourceBroker, sandbox/validation/promotion and SurrealDB/EventLedger'

STU-IO-189: Lightroom catalog/develop/WAL provenance MUST have explicit versioned per-entity mapping/loss outcomes; 'smart rules MUST be retained/translated/approximate/unsupported/missing explicitly; successful parser/count is not full conversion'; the .lrcat public API is fixed-format semantic extraction, never a generic table/query/database API
raw develop (14.12, line 20871): 'bounded explicit XMP interchange read/write through CKC is permitted as external transport, never live settings authority'
notes.owner_decision: CX-CAP-001 owner of the catalog model (goal 1), the query/filter engine (goal 2) and XMP sidecar write (goal 4 write half) is CKC (handshake_core atelier module, WP-KERNEL-005), which is not a crate in this workspace and is a forbidden dependency (WORKSPACE_RULES: never handshake_core). Building them in a Studio crate would violate STU-ASSET-004/017/019 and the lrcat 'no private catalog' clause, so no crate was created and nothing was registered; reported to the lead. In-spec alternative for the lead/steward: typed CKC provider-port contracts (asset.search query/filter request types, catalog mutation commands) in hsk-studio-kernel-bindings, which owns host-neutral bridge contracts (STU-ARC-010).
